four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- DiCarlo manifold untangling (two corpus entries, lit_status present). This run SHARPENS the reference read: an untangling failure predicts information present but tangled; the closed-form content witness instead shows the decision-relevant content is not linearly present at all. That is DISCARDING, not tangling -- a stronger and different missing-dependency signature (no objective anywhere in the training path preserves action-decision-relevant content).
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: present -- encoder trained, latent non-collapsed, oracle clears the demonstrator floor (45.75 res/ep worst seed), 1965 held-out labelled steps worst seed, 3 seeds, seed_majority 2 satisfied
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: complete -- the adapter IS x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN 128; all 32-dim arms carry identical action-path parameter counts (21381); adapter init re-seeded from the cell seed before every fit; per-cell substrate hashes agree (one distinct hash); validate_recording.py OK, no always-core gaps
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate -- the mapping demonstrably exists from the same stored steps (raw 25-dim field 0.979; uncompressed 250-dim input 0.939; PCA-32 of that input 0.868), all above the 0.80 bar. The environment is not the constraint
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented (NARROWLY, and in a NEW place) -- the 1002 debt is DISCHARGED (a 32-dim reference of the encoder's ACTUAL 250-dim input now exists and clears). The residual gap is specific: every leg-2 arm is an INVERTIBLE LINEAR 32x32 re-basis, which by the driver's own algebra leaves the adapter's function class IDENTICAL, so leg 2 can only ever measure LEARNING DYNAMICS, never information; and the content witness is a LINEAR decode. Whether the decision-relevant content survives NONLINEARLY, recoverable by an over-capacity decoder, is unmeasured by this run and by every run in the lineage. ONE FURTHER RESIDUE, surfaced by the Step 7c pass: the leg-2 VERDICT arm (ridge field-decode) is by far the worst-conditioned of the three re-bases -- per-seed condition numbers 2455-8902, against 68-102 for ZCA and 29.97-30.24 for LDA -- while the driver's own authoring-time calibration measures a random invertible reweighting of the raw field costing -0.025 at condition number 20 and -0.047 at 100, i.e. conditioning penalties of the same order as the entire effect under test. The conditioning gate was DEMOTED to a recorded witness (rebasis_witnesses) because it could not fire, so nothing in the run protects the verdict arm from a conditioning-induced suppression. This does not overturn the WEAKENED verdict (jointly gated on the content witness, which degrades 3/3) but it means the geometry contribution is bounded BELOW, not estimated
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: isolated by design -- the consumer is deliberately severed from the representation (BC from oracle labels removes credit assignment entirely). That is the manipulation, not a defect
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate -- 3 seeds x 10 arms, 8.96 h, ADAPTER_PASSES 60, positive control converged at 0.973-0.985; no gate bound marginally

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: DiCarlo-style ventral-stream manifold untangling: a population code carries a variable that is present yet unusable by a simple downstream readout until a cascade whose JOB is reshaping has flattened and separated the behaviourally relevant manifolds
dependencies: an objective/architecture whose purpose is that reshaping
a dorsal, action-formatted stream distinct from the ventral recognition stream
downstream readouts matched to the format the reshaping produces
biological_reference.divergence: REE's z_world is trained for sensory prediction (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) plus the SD-018 auxiliary field head -- objectives with no pressure to preserve the ACTION-relevant variable -- and every consumer reads the one shared prediction-trained latent, with no separate action-formatted stream. 1002 read the failure as an untangling failure. THIS run narrows it further: an untangling failure would leave the content linearly present but badly arranged, and three independent linear re-bases plus a closed-form linear-content witness say the decision-relevant content is not linearly present. The signature is DISCARDING at encode time, which is a missing-dependency finding (no objective preserves it), not a falsification of the untangling reference.
biological_reference.lit_status: present for the untangling principle (targeted_review_perceptual_manifold_adaptors 2026-06-12 dicarlo2012; targeted_review_sd_015 2026-04-02 dicarlo2007). targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1008 (2026-09-07, diagnostic PASS, claim-free) executed the parallel two-leg portfolio commissioned by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1002_2026-09-05 and returned BOTH legs. At identical width (32), identical reader (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, 21381 action-path params on every 32-dim arm), identical banked steps and identical standardiser, held-out top-1 oracle-action agreement is: raw 25-dim field 0.979 | uncompressed 250-dim world_state 0.939 | PCA-32 of that input 0.868 | random orthonormal 32-dim projection of that input 0.772 | LDA-whitened z_world 0.711 | ZCA-whitened z_world 0.708 | UNTRAINED z_world 0.695 | TRAINED (OFF) z_world 0.669 | field-decode re-based z_world 0.666, against a 0.80 bar and a 0.573 trivial baseline. LEG 1: H-E-channel-input-capacity is ELIMINATED -- a task-agnostic variance-optimal 32-dim LINEAR compression of the encoder's ACTUAL 250-dim input clears bar and elevation on 3/3 seeds, so the deficit is not a 250->32 channel-input bound and not dimensionality. (Plain, not strong, elimination: the random projection reaches 0.772 and does not clear 0.80. The PCA-minus-random margin cleared on 1/3 seeds and is REPORTED ATTRIBUTION only, deliberately not a conjunct of the verdict -- _adjudicate_leg1 takes four booleans and the margin is not among them.) LEG 2: H-C-geometry-mismatch is WEAKENED at its own pre-registered branch -- three independent information-preserving linear re-bases of the frozen latent (ridge field-decode, ZCA, Fisher/LDA whitening) are seed-majority FLAT, and the closed-form content witness (the oracle's own rule applied to the linearly decoded field, no adapter) DEGRADES to 0.593/0.591/0.607 against trivial 0.566/0.580/0.572, i.e. below what the learned reader already extracts. Read together: the deficit is neither channel WIDTH nor readout GEOMETRY; the observation->z_world encoding DISCARDS the decision-relevant content of its own input. Two qualifications recorded rather than smoothed: (a) the two whitening arms lift CONSISTENTLY 3/3 in the positive direction (ZCA +0.039, LDA +0.043 mean) -- a small REAL geometry effect, classified flat because it sits below the 0.05 marginal band, and roughly a third of the ~0.13 needed to reach the bar from 0.669; 'geometry contributes nothing' is too strong, 'geometry contributes about a third of what is needed' is right. (b) every leg-2 re-basis is an invertible linear 32x32 map, which by the driver's own stated algebra leaves the adapter's function class IDENTICAL, so leg 2 measures learning dynamics and the content witness measures LINEAR content only -- whether the content survives NONLINEARLY is unmeasured here and in every run of this lineage. Finally, and stated more weakly than the draft of this note first had it: the TRAINED latent is at or below its UNTRAINED control (0.669 vs 0.695, 3/3 seeds), as in V3-EXQ-1002 -- but this is NOT an independent replication. The warmup and dataset reproduce BIT-IDENTICALLY between the two runs (zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0 and zworld_not_collapsed match to full double precision; the rawfield_ceiling arm is bit-identical on 3/3 seeds), so only the adapter initialisation was re-drawn. The ordering is therefore robust to a READER-INIT re-draw and to an intervening substrate change, NOT to a warmup re-draw; it does not add a second independent instance behind H-D-warmup-not-the-locus, which continues to rest on V3-EXQ-1002 alone.

live_hypotheses: H-F-content-discarded-at-encode (NEW, to be pre-registered by this autopsy as labelled fan-out growth, ALIVE): the decision-relevant content of the observation is DISCARDED by the observation->z_world encoding and is not recoverable from the frozen latent by ANY decoder at any capacity. This is the direct NEGATION of the just-weakened H-C, not a re-entry of it: H-C asserted the content is present and linearly decodable but badly arranged; H-F asserts it is not there to arrange.

COMPLEMENT (H-F's declared elimination branch, deliberately NOT registered as a separate leg): the content IS present in the frozen latent but only nonlinearly, above the consumer's 32->128 capacity and format, so the block is a consumer-side interface FORMAT/CAPACITY bound rather than an encode-time loss. If an over-capacity decoder clears the bar, H-F is eliminated and THIS becomes the next registered leg -- registered then, by the autopsy that adjudicates it, rather than now, so the frozen denominator is not double-counted for one measurement.

suggested_probes.leg: PRIMARY -- the single fact that gates both candidate builds
suggested_probes.sketch: AN OVER-CAPACITY DECODER SWEEP ON THE ALREADY-BANKED FROZEN LATENTS. Same V3-EXQ-1002/1008 dataset, same seeds, same held-out episode split, same standardiser; the ONLY thing varied is the decoder's capacity -- sweep the reader from the consumer's exact x734.PPOPolicyNet (32->128, the 1008 arm, known 0.669) up through progressively wider/deeper MLPs to a deliberately over-parameterised decoder, and report BOTH the oracle-action agreement AND a direct nonlinear decode of the five DECISION_WORLD_STATE_INDICES {232,236,237,238,242}. Anchor every rung against the SAME sweep applied to ws250_pca (known 0.868) so the capacity axis is calibrated on a representation known to carry the content. DECLARED NULL: even the over-parameterised decoder stays below the 0.80 bar on the seed majority -> H-F CONFIRMED, the content is destroyed at encode time and the only repair is at the ENCODER's objective (sd_actor_critic_action_learning's co-shaping hint, or an action-formatted stream). CLEARS -> H-F ELIMINATED, the content survives but is inaccessible at the consumer's capacity/format, and the repair is interface reformatting rather than encoder retraining -- an entirely different and much cheaper build. ADDED AT THE STEP 7c PASS -- A FITTED LINEAR READOUT ARM, to de-confound the one in-run hint that nonlinear content exists. This run's only evidence on that point is that zworld_off_diag (0.669) beats the closed-form content witness (0.593-0.607) by 0.054-0.083 -- but those two readers differ in TWO ways, learned-vs-fixed rule AND nonlinear-vs-linear, because the witness applies the oracle's hand-specified argmax to a noisy linear decode while the adapter is fitted. A FITTED linear softmax on the frozen latent, at the bottom rung of the sweep, separates them: if it also reaches ~0.67 the gap is the fitting, not the nonlinearity.
suggested_probes.why_not_a_power_bump: This is NOT the lettered re-run the brake refuses. The brake refuses re-running the SAME design at more power to re-ask the SAME question. Here the DV, the question and the manipulated variable all change: 1008 held capacity FIXED at the consumer's width by design (that was its capacity_match requirement) and varied the input representation; this probe holds the representation fixed and varies capacity, which no run in the lineage has done.
suggested_probes.declared_null_note: The capacity sweep's null is one-sided by design and that is deliberate: a decoder that clears only at absurd capacity still eliminates H-F, because H-F asserts the content is not recoverable AT ANY capacity. Report the capacity at which it clears, if it does -- that number is what sizes the interface-reformat build.

suggested_probes.hypothesis: H-F (localisation, secondary -- run only if H-F is confirmed)
suggested_probes.leg: SECONDARY -- where in the encoder the content is lost
suggested_probes.sketch: A LAYER-WISE CONTENT PROBE. Decode the five decision coordinates from each intermediate tensor of the observation->z_world path (raw world_state -> each latent_stack stage -> z_world) on the banked episodes, and report the decode quality profile. DECLARED NULL: content is high at the input and falls monotonically with depth, with no single stage accounting for the loss (a distributed squeeze). A sharp single-stage drop instead NAMES the layer to change and converts the node from probe-gated to `complicated (buildable)` at that layer. Cheap: no ree_core change, no new warmup family, forward passes only.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1. Two DIFFERENT design axes (measurement: capacity sweep; process: layer-wise localisation), each with a declared null, neither a power-bump of the braked design. Only ONE new registry leg (H-F) is pre-registered, deliberately: its complement is H-F's own declared elimination branch, and registering both would inflate the frozen denominator by two for what is a single measurement. The secondary probe adjudicates no new leg -- it localises a confirmed H-F -- so it adds no leg either.
fanout_recommendation.axis_field_semantics_note: IMPORTANT FOR WHOEVER APPLIES THIS: `suggested_probes[].axis` is the PROBE's DESIGN axis, not the registered leg's axis. H-F's registry axis is `representation` (see registry_axis_for_H_F above and the hypothesis_space_ledger_pending block), NOT `measurement`. The predecessor artifact's probe axes happened to coincide with its legs' registry axes, which makes this an easy and consequential misread -- the axis value is what the convergence classifier buckets on.

learning_extracted: AT IDENTICAL WIDTH AND IDENTICAL READER, A FIXED VARIANCE-OPTIMAL LINEAR COMPRESSION OF THE ENCODER'S OWN INPUT BEATS THE TRAINED ENCODER BY 0.20 HELD-OUT AGREEMENT (0.868 vs 0.669), AND A RANDOM ORTHONORMAL PROJECTION OF IT BEATS THE ENCODER BY 0.10 (0.772). The observation->z_world encoding is not merely failing to improve on its input -- it is destroying task-relevant structure that a fixed linear map preserves. This is the sharpest statement of the v3 binding constraint the corpus carries.

BULK LINEAR DECODABILITY IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT DECISION-RELEVANT CONTENT SURVIVES, AND THIS LINEAGE NEARLY ROUTED ON THAT INFERENCE. V3-EXQ-978 measured field decode r2 0.710 (sense) / 0.858 (encoder) from z_world and its own null table concluded 'z_world already carries the field, so the deficit is in the CONSUMER'. V3-EXQ-1008's closed-form witness -- the oracle's OWN argmax rule applied to that same linearly decoded field -- reaches 0.593 against a 0.566 trivial baseline. r2 averages over 25 field coordinates; the oracle reads 5 of them and takes an argmax, so a decode that is good on average can be worthless where the decision lives. GENERALISABLE GUARD: when a decode r2 is used to argue content adequacy, always report the decision-relevant projection of it, applied through the actual decision rule, not the aggregate.

A CRITERION THAT IS FUNCTION-CLASS-PRESERVING BY ALGEBRA CAN ONLY EVER MEASURE LEARNING DYNAMICS, AND THE DRIVER SAYING SO IS WHAT MAKES THE LEG READABLE. Every leg-2 arm is an invertible linear 32x32 re-basis, absorbable by the adapter's first layer (W' = W R^-1), so information content is identical BY ALGEBRA across leg-2 arms and a lift can come only from optimisation dynamics. The driver states this in its own docstring and correspondingly requires the closed-form content witness to be non-lifting before the WEAKENED branch may fire. Read the other way round, this is a standing caution: a 'flat re-basis' result is NOT by itself evidence about information, and an autopsy that read it as such would have over-claimed.

GEOMETRY CONTRIBUTES SOMETHING, ABOUT A THIRD OF WHAT IS NEEDED, AND THE SEED-MAJORITY BAND CLASSIFIES THAT AS 'FLAT'. Both whitening arms lift consistently in the positive direction on 3/3 seeds (ZCA +0.040/+0.030/+0.048, LDA +0.042/+0.033/+0.052) and are binned flat because only one seed reaches the 0.05 marginal band. Against the ~0.13 needed to lift 0.669 to the 0.80 bar, that is a real but insufficient effect. The verdict is correct on its pre-registered terms; the PROSE must not therefore say geometry contributes nothing.
